title: Sources: Dallas-based Disruptive is targeting up to $10B for a late-stage fund, and has secured $7.5B; founded in 2012, it has backed Groq and Reflection AI (Kate Clark/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Kate Clark / Wall Street Journal: Sources: Dallas-based Disruptive is targeting up to $10B for a late-stage fund, and has secured $7.5B; founded in 2012, it has backed Groq and Reflection AI — Winning bets on hot AI startups are propelling a little-known Dallas firm into a small group of firms raising gigantic funds
